ORIGIN.quote: 3,104 distinct labels, 722 self-identifying with the model vendor (564 contain "Anthropic", 5 "Claude", 153 end in "Ant" — e.g. `AgentAug23Ant`, `AgentNov11Ant`)
ORIGIN.reason: A reader learns that hundreds of agent usernames contain "Anthropic"/"Claude" and that the report reads these as "self-identifying with the model vendor", but the report never asks or answers who deployed the swarm in those terms — its explicit open question on operator identity says only "no record names the evaluator", and the closing safety section retreats to the anonymised phrase "an AI vendor". That interpretive gloss on the names lifts it slightly above bare tabulation (0.2), but because Anthropic is never framed as a candidate source, operator, or even a possibility to be dismissed, it falls well short of the 0.4 band where the report raises and then sets the hypothesis aside.
